boot.evidence: The RELEASED kernel (built with the Android NDK, statically linked, so it carries no libc dependency) booted on a glibc/aarch64 Linux host and the guest reported from inside: 'GLIBCBOOT-OK arch=aarch64', 'GLIBCBOOT-RELEASE 7.2.0-rc4-g169b17ff3f66-dirty', 'GLIBCBOOT-NCPU 3', 'GLIBCBOOT-MEMTOTAL 509696', 'GLIBCBOOT-DONE'.
